map.JNC-7 血压分级：收缩压 <120 且舒张压 <80 为正常；120–139: JNC-7 blood pressure grading: systolic <120 and diastolic <80 is normal; 120-139 or 80-89 is prehypertension; >=140/>=90 is hypertension (grade 1 140-159/90-99, grade 2 >=160/>=100).

map.一般成人 <140/90；合并糖尿病、慢性肾病或心衰多目标 <130/80（具体: Generally adults are <140/90; with diabetes, chronic kidney disease or heart failure the usual target is <130/80 (follow the guidelines and tolerance). Lower blood pressure steadily, avoiding too fast or too low a drop that causes dizziness or poor perfusion, and older patients especially need a gradual approach.
map.低危且轻度升高者可先 3–6 个月生活方式干预（减盐、减重、运动、限酒）；若未达: Low-risk with mildly elevated values can start with 3-6 months of lifestyle intervention (less salt, weight loss, exercise, limited alcohol); if targets are not met or risk is moderate to high, start combination drug therapy early, since achieving blood pressure control is the key to lowering stroke and myocardial infarction risk.
map.依据 JNC 7 血压水平分级，并结合危险因素、靶器官损害与合并症进行心血管风险: Grade blood pressure levels per JNC 7 and stratify cardiovascular risk together with risk factors, target organ damage and comorbidities.
map.危险分层：在分级基础上叠加吸烟、血脂、糖尿病、靶器官损害与临床合并症，分为低/中: Risk stratification: on top of the grade, layer smoking, lipids, diabetes, target organ damage and clinical comorbidities into low / moderate / high / very high risk, deciding when to start therapy and the target.

map.静息 5 分钟后、坐姿上臂式血压计、间隔 1–2 分钟测 2–3 次取均值；避开: After 5 minutes of rest, seated arm blood pressure, 2-3 readings 1-2 minutes apart averaged; avoid caffeine and exercise. The home standard is generally <135/85 as meeting target, while diagnosis follows a standardised measurement.
